title: Targeted Plasma Membrane Delivery of a Hydrophobic Cargo Encapsulated in a Liquid Crystal Nanoparticle Carrier
protocol: Dissolve liquid crystalline diacrylate cross-linking agent (DACTP11, 45 mg), DiO (2 mg), and azobisisobutyronitrile (1 mg) in 2 ml of chloroform.
Add the solution to an aqueous solution of acrylate-functionalized surfactant (AC10COONa, 13 mg in 7 ml).
Stir the mixture for 1 hour.
Sonicate the mixture at 80% amplitude for 5 minutes.
Heat the mixture to 64 °C in an oil bath to initiate polymerization.
Filter the NP suspension three times through a 0.2 µm syringe filter.
Store the filtered NP solution at 4 °C until further use.
Dissolve Chol-PEG-NH2·HCl (PEG-Chol, 0.9 mM) in 25 mM HEPES buffer (pH 7.0).
Prepare a working solution containing NHSS (40 mM) and EDC (400 mM) in HEPES buffer.
Add 20 µl of the NHSS/EDC working solution to 1.0 ml of DiO-LCNP in HEPES buffer.
Stir for 5 minutes.
Add 20 µl of stock solution of Chol-PEG-NH2·HCl to the mixture.
Stir the reaction mixture for 2 hours.
Centrifuge the reaction mixture at maximum speed (~2,000 x g) for 30 seconds.
Pass the supernatant through a PD-10 size exclusion chromatography column equilibrated with Dulbecco's phosphate-buffered saline (DPBS, 0.1x).
Dissolve 0.5 g of agarose in 50 ml of tris-borate electrophoresis (TBE) buffer.
Heat the solution to dissolve the agarose and allow it to cool slightly.
Pour the agarose solution into a gel plate in the electrophoresis box.
Insert a gel comb to create sample wells.
Once the gel has solidified, add TBE running buffer to the chamber.
Add 35 µl of DiO-LCNP sample (amended with glycerol, 5% v/v) to the wells of the gel.
Run the gel for 20 minutes at a voltage of 110 V.
Image the gel using a gel imaging system with excitation and emission filters at 488 nm and 500-550 nm.
Coat 35 mm diameter tissue culture dishes with bovine fibronectin (~100 μl, 20 μg/ml) in DPBS for 2 hours at 37°C.
Remove the fibronectin coating solution from the culture dish.
Harvest HEK 293T/17 cells by washing cell monolayer with 3 ml of DPBS.
Add 2 ml of trypsin-EDTA (0.5%) to the T-25 flask and incubate at 37°C for ~3 minutes.
Remove the trypsin-EDTA from the flask.
Return the flask to the incubator until cells are detached.
Neutralize the trypsin by adding 4 ml of complete medium (DMEM with 10% fetal bovine serum, 5% sodium pyruvate, and 5% antibiotic/antimycotic) to the flask.
Determine the cell concentration in the suspension by counting cells in a cell counter.
Adjust the cell concentration to ~8 x 10^4 cells/ml with growth medium.
Add 3 ml of the cell suspension to the dish.
Culture in the incubator overnight.
Remove the growth medium from the culture dishes using a serological pipette.
Wash the cell monolayers two times with HEPES-DMEM (2 ml each wash).
Perform the washes by gently adding and removing HEPES-DMEM using a pipette to/from the edge of the dishes.
Add 0.2 ml of the prepared DiOfree or DiO-LCNP delivery solutions to the center of the culture dishes.
Return the dishes to the incubator for an appropriate period of time (typically 15 or 30 min).
Remove the delivery solutions using a serological pipette after the incubation period.
Wash the cell monolayers two times with DPBS (2 ml each wash) by gently adding and removing DPBS from/to the edge of the dish.
Fix the cell monolayers using 4% paraformaldehyde in DPBS for 15 min at room temperature.
Remove the paraformaldehyde solution using a pipette.
Gently wash the cells one time with DPBS (2 ml) by adding and removing DPBS from/to the edge of the dishes.
Prepare the fixed cells to be imaged for the presence of membranous fluorescence signal using confocal laser scanning microscopy immediately or store them at 4 °C in DPBS containing 0.05% NaN3.
Replace the medium with DPBS containing 0.05% NaN3 for storage if imaging is not immediate.
Label cells sequentially with DiO-LCNP-PEG-Chol and DiIfree using the method described in step 4.
Wash the labeled cells once with DPBS (2 ml) using a serological pipette.
Replace wash buffer with 2 ml of live cell imaging solution (LCIS).
Image the live cell sample on a microscope stage equipped with a heated incubation chamber.
Use a confocal microscope (60X objective) to image the sample in FRET configuration at 488 nm excitation and collect full emission spectra from 490-700 nm over a 4 hr period, imaging every 30 min.
Harvest HEK 293 T1/7 cells from the T-25 flask as described in step 3.2.
Seed HEK 293T/17 cells at a density of 5,000 cells per well in 100 µl HEPES-DMEM onto a 96-well tissue culture-treated plate.
Culture the seeded cells for 24 hours.
Remove the culture medium from each well using a micropipette.
Add 50 µl of HEPES-DMEM containing DiO-free, DiO-LCNPs, or DiO-LCNP-PEG-Chol at increasing concentrations to replicate wells.
Incubate cells with the added materials for 30 minutes at 37 °C.
Remove the delivery medium containing the materials using a micropipette.
Replace the removed medium with 100 µl of growth medium in each well.
Culture the cells under these conditions for 72 hours.
Add 20 µl of the tetrazolium substrate to each well.
Return the plate to the incubator.
Incubate at 37 °C for 4 hr to allow color formation to proceed.
Read the absorbance of the formazan product at 570 nm using a microtiter plate reader.
Read the nonspecific background absorbance at 650 nm using a microtiter plate reader.
Plot the differential absorbance value (abs570 - abs650) versus material concentration.
Report the results as percent of control cell proliferation.
